subject: Post-demo follow-up: MAP draft + SOC 2 delivery calendar
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@finovatesolutions.com>, Tom Bauer <tom.bauer@finovatesolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-03T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: MAP draft + SOC 2 delivery calendar

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Helpful conversation — appreciate the clarity on your internal security gating and procurement windows. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the security review milestone and SOC 2 evidence delivery. High-level asks below.

Quick summary (TL;DR)
- Target close (contract signed): 2027-06-30 (customer preference for end of Q2)
- Near-term milestone we discussed: Security review sign-off + SOC 2 evidence intake (critical path)
- Next step: confirm ownership & evidence due dates so Redwood can prep the package and schedule a security walkthrough.

Proposed MAP milestone (security gate) — draft
1) Customer security questionnaire (we will provide a pre-filled version) — Owner: Finovate Solutions — Due: 2027-04-14
2) SOC 2 evidence index (Redwood delivers list + templates) — Owner: Redwood (Marissa) — Deliverable: index spreadsheet + evidence stubs — Due: 2027-04-07
3) Evidence upload & intake review — Owner: Finovate Solutions — Due: 2027-04-21
4) Security walkthrough (technical call) — Owner: Redwood & Finovate — Scheduled: week of 2027-04-25 (TBD)
5) Final sign-off for security gate — Owner: Finovate Solutions — Target: 2027-05-05

Dependencies we flagged today:
- Finovate needs to confirm whether a third-party auditor (internal SOC 2 lead) will need direct access to Redwood audit logs — if yes, that adds 1–2 weeks for an access request.
- Procurement timeline tied to your legal redlines; we can run a parallel docs track but security sign-off needs to be finished before final PO.

Immediate asks for you
- Please confirm the person who will own the questionnaire (name & email) and whether there are any special evidence formats you require (S3 links, CSV, or PDF).

Internal note: Marissa, I attached the MAP v0.2 PDF and will need the SOC 2 evidence index by EOD Wednesday so we can hand it to Elena. Priyom, can you prepare the evidence stubs and the KMS/HSM answer matrix?

Best,
Markus
Markus Klein
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: MAP-v0.2.pdf)

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@finovatesolutions.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Bauer <tom.bauer@finovatesolutions.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: MAP draft + SOC 2 delivery calendar

Thanks Markus — this is very clear and helpful.

Quick answers:
- I'll own the questionnaire and evidence collection; please use elena.soto@finovatesolutions.com for any intake links.
- We prefer evidence as PDF or S3 links; if you can provide a consolidated index (spreadsheet) + direct upload instructions, that will make the intake much faster.
- On access: we do expect our internal compliance lead to want read-only access to audit logs for a brief review. I'll confirm the name tomorrow (likely our security lead, Priya Nair).

On dates: the earlier dates you listed look fine. One ask: can Redwood deliver the evidence index by 2027-04-06 instead of the 7th? We have a small blackout week starting 4/15, so getting things into our queue earlier helps.

Happy to jump on a 30m call to walk the questionnaire once you send it over.

Elena

Priyom / Marissa —

Elena asked for the evidence index one day earlier (2027-04-06). Can we accelerate? Below is a condensed action list I want to send to the customer once we align. Please reply with your ETA.

Action items (internal)
- Marissa: produce SOC 2 evidence index spreadsheet (column: evidence name, expected format, Redwood owner, sample path). Deliverable: redwood-soc2-evidence-index.xlsx. Requested due: 2027-04-06 EOD.
- Priyom: generate evidence stubs and KMS/HSM matrix (doc) + short note on retained logs retention windows. Deliverable: evidence stubs (.pdf placeholders) and kms-hsm-matrix.docx. Requested due: 2027-04-06 noon.
- Markus: schedule walkthrough slot options for week of 4/25 after evidence ingestion window closes.

Notes: if Priyom can pre-populate a handful of high-value artifacts (e.g., infra diagram, key rotation policy excerpt, sample audit log) we can attach placeholders and label them as "sample stubs" per Elena's preference.

I want Marissa to be the visible owner when we send the intake link. Priyom please confirm whether any of the stubs are gated by infra requests; if they are, state what the self-service path is.

Thanks — shout if timeline is impossible.
Markus
(Internal only)

Marissa — I'll drop the stub PDFs into the shared folder: https://docs.redwood.com/shared/Finovate-MAP-v0.2 and will flag which items need follow-up. Once you produce the index spreadsheet I'll attach the filenames.

Priyom
